propositions: The divergent_implementation axis fires on only 7.72% of plan-v3 findings and is the only hard-override axis never calibrated with concrete grades; a G6 finding with validity 0.8889 scored impact 0.0 and landed advisory rather than blocking because all seven axes were graded none, despite the finding describing a real unscoped consumer class.

Replacing the ordinal none|low|medium|high grades with a closed Literal (contradicts_reality, omits_required_site, incomplete_enumeration, none) partitions load-bearing divergence from cosmetic; incomplete_enumeration contributes below all blocking thresholds and never floors, while the two override grades floor at 0.85, making the axis itself the calibration target rather than severity bands.

The prod_impact floor (Fix 2) structurally collides with the novelty-based convergence floor (novelty_priority_floor = 0.4) because it lifts unbounded severity bands that authors cannot remediate by plan edits, whereas divergence-grading lifts a semantically bounded, remediable class; Fix 2 escapes 4.99% of the convergence reservoir versus Fix 1's 2.68%, and inverts an established ordering that pinned underspecified-oracle below all thresholds.

The impact_plan resolution must exclude divergent_implementation from the generic _SEV01 contribution loop and drive both contribution and override checks through a new _PLAN_GRADED_AXES set, mirroring ac_unverifiable exactly, so that the two kind-graded axes cannot drift apart and schema-only changes do not silently stop firing.

ADR-0054 rejects purpose-built LLM eval suites and bulk re-review runs as calibration instruments, permitting only zero-marginal-cost corpus replay (bracketing outcomes under best/worst grade mappings) and dogfood observation, narrowing ADR-0036's A/B clause while preserving the permissive-rollout invariant and version-segmentation discipline.

Corpus replay bracketing shows the worst case adds 81 net blocks across 1,396 non-none findings (a bounded increase, not a flood, far below the 113-finding over-fire an ungraded widening would produce), with 79 dropped findings invariant, confirming the three-way split achieves the pressure-release design and convergence remains possible.
